description: Generate ready-to-paste MCP server config for Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf from one input. Config completeness decides whether developers can install your server at all.

args.description: JSON array of command arguments. Accepts a JSON array, or a JSON string containing one.

command.description: Launch command for stdio servers (e.g. npx)

env.description: JSON object of environment variables. Accepts a JSON object, or a JSON string containing one.

serverName.description: Server name used as the config key

name: generate_mcp_client_config
